actions.action_en: Check the potting mix. Let it dry slightly between waterings. Once it has dried a little, water thoroughly.
actions.action_pl: Sprawdź podłoże. Pozwól mu lekko przeschnąć między podlewaniami. Gdy lekko przeschnie, podlej obficie.

source_documents.use_basis: Editorial paraphrase of a reviewed horticultural fact for this staging derived record. No publisher text or image is imported, stored, republished or licensed by this record.

/actions/0.scope: Routine indoor care for potted Monstera deliciosa. Slight drying is a condition for watering, without a fixed interval.
